label: rem:descent-reduction-two
title: Reduction at dimension 2
html:
When \dim M_k = 2, the geometric data of the archimedean quantum observable universe are those of a closed surface. This is the stratum Bring's surface occupies: the geometric descent chain of Bring's surface as a QOU passes through \Sigma_4 at this dimension.

  1. Connection. The \mathrm{SU}(2) connection A_k retains its full non-abelian character — its curvature F_A is a Lie-algebra-valued 2-form, and the holonomy around loops in the surface is in general non-abelian, exactly as at the stratum above. What changes is degree: F_A is now of top degree, so no 3-form survives on a 2-manifold and the inert 3-curvature of the Yekutieli tower has no support here.
  2. Bundle. Principal \mathrm{SU}(2) bundles over a closed orientable surface are classified by \pi_1(\mathrm{SU}(2)) = 0 and are therefore trivial. The universe's content at this stratum lies entirely in the connection, not in the topology of \mathcal{S}.
  3. Reeb direction. The Reeb direction is not merely constrained here — it is what the descent step removed. The passage from \dim M_k = 3 is the Reeb quotient, so the q-Reeb vector field (q-Reeb vector field) has been divided out and the horizontal distribution is the whole tangent space.

The descent continues to a 1-dimensional base (descent reduction), where the remaining two directions collapse to the longitudinal \mathrm{U}(1) backbone.
